title: Cheap Gaming Laptops That Still Run New Games (2026)
summary: Acer Nitro V, HP Victus, Lenovo LOQ and ASUS TUF are the budget gaming laptops reviewers name most often.
method: Picks come from Engadget, TechRadar, Empire, GeekChamp, UDN's laptop blog and LaptopMedia. Only models or lines named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because gaming-laptop prices and configurations change often. GPU wattage, RAM and cooling vary a lot between versions, so check the exact configuration before you buy.

products.name: Acer Nitro V 15
why: TechRadar names the Acer Nitro V 15 its standout budget gaming laptop for 1080p performance, and Empire picks the Nitro V15 as its best overall gaming laptop under £1000. GeekChamp recommends it for esports and budget buyers.
LaptopMedia's March 2026 Amazon USA chart had the Nitro V 15 among the best-selling gaming laptops.
cons: Plastic build and battery life drops fast while gaming
Check RAM: some configs ship with 8GB
products.best_for: Budget gamers who want the safest all-round pick
products.skip_if: You want a metal build or all-day battery while gaming

products.name: HP Victus 15
why: Engadget names the HP Victus 15.6-inch its best budget gaming laptop. Empire calls the Victus its best budget gaming laptop under £1000, with a focus on playable performance rather than headline specs.
LaptopMedia says Victus is not HP's cheapest gaming line but gives the best offers.
products.best_for: Buyers who want a balanced, affordable gaming laptop
products.skip_if: You want the strongest GPU for your money

products.name: Lenovo LOQ 15 / LOQ 16
why: GeekChamp's top overall pick under $1000 is a discounted LOQ 15 or LOQ 16 with an RTX 4060. Empire calls the LOQ 15 the best 15-inch gaming laptop under £1000 and says it punches above its weight.
UDN's laptop blog describes the LOQ 15 as a budget-friendly esports machine with strong 1080p performance and a Hyperchamber cooling design.
cons: Only the discounted RTX 4060 versions hit the best value (GeekChamp)
products.best_for: Players who want the most GPU for the least money
products.skip_if: You want a premium all-metal build

products.name: ASUS TUF Gaming A15 / A16
why: Empire names the ASUS TUF Gaming A15 its best durable gaming laptop under £1000. GeekChamp calls the TUF A15 especially practical for gaming plus school.
UDN's laptop blog says the TUF Gaming A16 offers solid performance and a big, vibrant screen at an affordable price.
pros: Large vibrant screen on the A16 (UDN)
products.best_for: Gamers who also use the laptop for school or work
products.skip_if: You want the lightest laptop to carry
